title: Fontina Chicken and Broccoli Rotini
description: Chicken thighs and Impastable rotini share one skillet of sauce, with fresh broccoli folded into a smooth Fontina finish.

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.note: Use plain, unenhanced poultry. Remove visible fat before weighing.

ingredients.name: fresh broccoli florets
ingredients.note: Cut into small, evenly sized florets; use only fresh broccoli.

ingredients.name: low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.note: Use plain chicken-and-water broth without a vegetable blend or added seasoning.

ingredients.name: hot water
ingredients.note: Keep ready to replace liquid absorbed by the pasta.

steps.title: Start the chicken
steps.text: Cut {chicken} across the grain into 3/4-inch pieces. Bring {broth} to a gentle simmer in the HexClad and lower in the chicken. Cover and poach for 4 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the rotini in sauce
steps.text: Stir {rotini} directly into the chicken broth. Return to a steady simmer and cook for the package time, checking from 8 minutes. Stir every 2–3 minutes and add {extra} as needed to keep the spirals surrounded by liquid.

steps.title: Pull the thigh pieces
steps.text: Start checking the chicken after 10 minutes total. Lift pieces as their centers reach 175°F into a warm covered bowl with a spoonful of cooking liquid. Continue cooking the rotini in its original liquid until tender.

steps.title: Steam the fresh broccoli
steps.text: When the pasta is nearly tender, scatter {broccoli} over it and cover for 2–4 minutes. Lift out the florets when bright green and crisp-tender and place with the chicken.

steps.title: Build the Fontina base
steps.text: Stir {milk} and {nutmeg} into the pasta without draining it. Bring to a gentle simmer. Loosen with any reserved hot water so there is about 5/8 cup of free sauce per serving.

steps.title: Thicken around the pasta
steps.text: Fold the slurry into the bubbling liquid between the spirals. Simmer for 1 minute, until the sauce coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Melt the cheese
steps.text: Remove from heat and stir in {fontina} until smooth. Fold in the reserved chicken, its juices and the broccoli, and serve immediately with sauce around each portion.

notes: Sauce yield: About 1 1/4 cups for two, in addition to the pasta and vegetables. Make ahead: Cut the chicken and broccoli ahead and keep them refrigerated separately. Grate the cheese before starting so it melts quickly at the finish. For dairy-free portions, use plain unsweetened oat milk and replace the Fontina with a spoonful of unsalted cashew cream. Chill leftovers promptly in shallow portions and refrigerate for up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: No. Rotini absorbs the sauce and the broccoli softens after freezing; this dish is best cooked for two. Fridge reheat: Warm one portion covered in its sauce in a HexClad skillet over medium-low, loosening with a splash of water if needed. Stir or turn the chicken gently, checking from 6 minutes, until it reaches 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: If already frozen, thaw overnight in the refrigerator and follow the fridge reheating directions. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 320 kcal, 39.2 g protein, 43.4 g total carbohydrate, 9.7 g fat, 27.9 g fiber, 469 mg sodium. Includes the measured broth and sauce. Sodium varies with your broth.
